name: unpeople
label: Rank of no people contact when unemployed

questions.text:
Suppose you were unemployed and couldn't find a job. Which of the following problems would be the worst?  Please write '1' in the box beside the worst thing, write '2' in the box beside the next worst thing, and '3' beside the third worst thing. Leave the other boxes blank. 
A. Lack of contact with people at work
